input: Sign up for a wilderness first responder course

gold.taskTitle: Sign Up for a Wilderness First Responder Course
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and register for a Wilderness First Responder (WFR) certification course.

questions.title: Do you already have a specific provider in mind?
questions.description: Identify whether the user has a preferred WFR course provider such as NOLS, Wilderness Medical Associates, or SOLO.

questions.title: What is your target completion date for this course?
questions.description: Determine the user's timeline or deadline for completing the WFR certification.

questions.title: What city or region do you want to take this course?
questions.description: Establish the user's preferred geographic location for an in-person course, or whether remote/hybrid options are acceptable.

questions.title: Is this your first WFR cert or a recertification?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user is pursuing an initial WFR certification or renewing an existing one, as course requirements differ.

questions.title: Do you have a budget limit for this course?
questions.description: Understand any financial constraints, since WFR courses typically range from $600 to over $900.

questions.title: Is this required by an employer, organization, or personal interest?
questions.description: Determine the purpose behind getting certified, which may influence which provider or certification level is most appropriate.

questions.title: Do you have scheduling constraints during the course days?
questions.description: Find out if the user has availability limitations, since WFR courses are typically 8 to 10 consecutive days.
